notes.title: New Update Plan
notes.notes:
Oof, it's been a while. This is the brand-spanking new update plan to track Puzzzle's development over eternity. Enjoy what I've cooked up!

Indev:                                                                                               
Now - April 16th

This stage will be divided into three parts:

DVTStage // Now - March 10th 
HDVStage // May 10th - March 31st
FDVStage // March 31st - April 16th

"DVTStage" or Development Tracking Stage is essentially housekeeping for the game, like working on patches, listening to user feedback, meeting small deadlines and making sure the game is ready for the "HDVStage", or Heavy Development Stage. This stage is where I fix larger bugs, add more levels, add a heavier emphasis to actual puzzles and add what you've all been waiting for... level select (woohoo!). "FDVStage" or Final Development Stage is where I polish what's been done in the last stage, and get the game ready for...

Outdev:
April 22nd - June 30th

This stage will be divided into two parts:

DVTStage // April 20th - April 30th
HDVStage // April 30th - June 30th

These stages are just like before, but in this HDVStage, there'll be even more fun stuff!

Postdev
July 12th - Until I make a new game

This is where I'll continually update, patch, and apply maintenance to the game after the major updates are done. You'll see a max of two more major updates here, then it'll just be small patches (so sad).

This entire process will be done on my youtube channel, and I mean every single thing, from the odd patch to the big updates. Check it out to stay updated. I'll think about making a twitter, but I don't know yet. 

-Thanks, Stephen Walton, "dev"

notes.title: Update 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

-Pause menu improved (character freezes)
-Added Main Menu feature (you can remove the UI and press 'Escape' to go back)
-Added progress bar for the game (Settings menu -> bottom left button)
-Level 21 end trigger fixed
-Level 20 collider fixed (you can no longer jump out of the map)
-Riding horizontal moving platforms properly (NOTE: vertical moving platforms not yet properly integrated)
- Performance patches
-Level 101 (cool)




-Thanks for reading! If there are any issues, just comment on this post!

-Stephen Walton, "dev"

notes.title: Puzzzle Update Plan
notes.notes:
Here is the update plan for Puzzzle. It will take place over the next 2 or 3 months.

Version 1.1 - Minor / Major fixes in terms of bugs, performance, etc.

Version 1.2 - New minor features added to the game and improved UI. (E.g. Level selection).

Version 1.3 - Level redesign. All levels will be tweaked in some way to improve them, and more levels will 
                     be added in general. (E.g. Obstacles moved, wall-height changed, etc).

Version 1.4 - New obstacles added. Maybe 2 or 3 new obstacles will join the party.

Version 1.5 - Final update (for now), at least 200 levels in the game, almost all bugs fixed, new enemies, 
                     new levels, new helper objects, new UI, better movement mechanics, all "secret levels" 
                     implemented + much more!

Again, these changes will not be spontaneous but will happen over the course of 2 or 3 months of work. I may or may not document the process on my Youtube Channel (https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCkzo_oahtIoaIxzyiqQjTog/featured?view_as=subscriber), I will decide. I will release a notification on Steam after each update so you can see the progress I'm making. I will probably also add an update progress bar in the actual game so you can track it there too. 

-Thanks, Stephen Walton, "dev"
